acceptance_criterion.claim: selected candidate is worth experimental validation
acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Matches E5 after normalization, but E5 showed substantially greater viscosity drift from 15 to 60 min at 120 C than E1.
Matches E2 after normalization and has extensive temperature measurements, but no supplied 120 C thermal-hold series.
Close in composition to S1C01, but its hold behavior was not measured and cannot be inferred reliably.

selection_rationale: S1C01 is the normalized E1 formulation and has the strongest supplied hold evidence: viscosity increased from 708.7 at 15 min to 776.1 at 60 min at 120 C, less relative drift than the measured E5/S1C05 reference.

evidence_coverage.note: Thermal-hold data cover only E1 and E5, with one reported hold series for each.

extrapolation.note: S1C01 compositionally matches E1 after normalization, minimizing composition extrapolation, but validation under the intended process remains necessary.

measurement.note: Viscosity units and measurement method were not supplied.

process_history.note: Preparation and prior thermal or storage history were not provided.

repeatability.note: No replicate thermal-hold series was supplied; temperature-series runs also show run-to-run variability.
